producer: S8 bounded slice-supervisor legacy role migration

judgments.subject: slice-supervisor role projection
judgments.conclusion: Supervisor campaign judgment is retained as a role while durable campaign mechanics remain mediated server services; this package does not transfer deterministic owner authority into the role.

judgments.subject: legacy implementation review seam
judgments.conclusion: Review remains an explicit fail-closed compatibility boundary; native review semantics and retirement remain deferred.

judgments.subject: retained reviewer actor binding
judgments.conclusion: Before each provider crossing, the retained supervisor or builder uses manage_active_slice.py bind-actor with the exact active identity, expected revision, and stable event ID; its compare-and-swap and replay identity prevent stale or conflicting writes from losing the provider session or resuming the wrong reviewer continuation.

judgments.subject: slice-builder developer instruction projection
judgments.conclusion: The runtime manifest gives the retained builder a compact host-composed reminder to use mediated campaign, checkpoint/profile, receipt, publication, Claim Evidence, and context-lifecycle owners; this reminder does not transfer supervisor or deterministic-owner authority to the builder.
